item.coloph: bcom ldan 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bstod phyag 'tshal/ dge slong ma zla mdzes kyis bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /'di ni rgya gar shar phyogs kyi btsun pa tsan+d+ra shrI'i dag las 'byung ba dang rgya dpe bstun nas dge slong bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang po mgon po mchog la bstod pa' yi/ bsod nams gang zhing zla ba dung ltar dkar ba des/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo de ltar bur/ sdug bsngal 'gro ma mi 'jigs rtsos ba nyid gyur cig /ral pa 'chang zhing shin tu zhi ba yangs pa'i spyan/ rtag par rab tu dang ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal/ lha dang lha min rnams kyis zhabs kyi 'dam skyes la/ phyag byas nor bu pad+ma la byung mgon por 'dud/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ glu'i rgyal po nor rgyal kyis bstod pa/ dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal sngar bsod nams rnam par rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o
